predicate.label: expelled or deported
predicate.definition: Authority or acting group X forcibly expelled or deported person Y or explicitly affected members of population Y.
includes: explicit expulsion or deportation by X of Y
historical forced removal of identified members of a population
excludes: assuming every member of a named population was expelled
ambiguous: unclear expelling authority or affected people
leaving under pressure without an explicit expulsion or deportation
predicate.notes: Direction is expelling authority to affected person/population. The source territory is a separate omitted role; this does not identify a destination.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit expulsion or deportation by X of Y; historical forced removal of identified members of a population. Excludes: barring entry without removal; ordinary voluntary departure; killing, occupation or criticism alone; assuming every member of a named population was expelled. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear expelling authority or affected people; proposed expulsion without established action; leaving under pressure without an explicit expulsion or deportation. Direction is expelling authority to affected person/population. The source territory is a separate omitted role; this does not identify a destination.

rationale: Deport, expel and possessive deportation form the largest specific coherent family, three paths versus two negotiation paths and singleton policy/treatment/kill/bar paths. Catalogue reviewer independently approved the atomic removal predicate.
